component.name: Network Monitor
component.summary: Live network bandwidth, connections, and history dashboard

description.p: Network Monitor is a native, real-time network dashboard for Linux desktops: download/upload bandwidth, latency, active TCP/UDP connections, per-process network activity, Wi-Fi analysis, a read-only firewall ruleset viewer, VPN profile switching, and long-term traffic history, all backed by real system data with nothing simulated.

ul.li: Live bandwidth, latency, and connection charts with hover tooltips
Per-connection sent/received byte counters and live throughput
A Geo-IP map of remote peers with city, country, and network registrant
Wi-Fi network analysis and nearby access point scanning
Interface, bonding, and LAN device inventory
Built-in speed test, ping, traceroute, packet capture, and port scan
Traffic anomaly alerts with optional desktop notifications
CSV history export and a configurable monthly data usage cap
System tray icon with a live bandwidth label

description.p: Everything runs locally against a SQLite database on your own machine — no telemetry, no accounts, no cloud dependency.
